## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Core build and tests pass locally.
- [ ] Relevant desktop platform build passes.
- [ ] UI changes were checked in light and dark themes.
- [ ] Parser/converter/security changes include tests.
- [ ] Documentation and privacy boundaries are updated when needed.
- [ ] No real user data, credential, key or generated build output is included.

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visual changes. Use synthetic input only.
